1.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 1 | CC
1.description: Agriculture master's grad Xu Yan bombs a job interview, then wakes up in a thunderstorm as a penniless scholar in Liuxi Village, 20 taels in debt, with a Matchmaker System in his head. An officer kicks in the door with a marriage decree: three brides, married today. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 1.

2.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 2 | CC
2.description: Xu Yan has three days to marry three brides, or the System erases him. Qin Shuang wants him to chop firewood first, Tang Xiaotang wants a household registration, not a husband, and A-Ling won't say a word. Then Squire Qian shows up with his servants to take people in place of the 20 taels. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 2.

3.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 3 | CC
3.description: A hatchet thuds into the doorframe, and Qin Shuang says one word: "Let go." Squire Qian wants the three brides written into the bond; Xu Yan cites the Daheng Code and pledges his house, his land and himself instead: 20 taels in three days. The System's starter pack is a blurry soap recipe. He pays A-Ling a smooth compliment, and her affection drops to -5 on the spot. At midnight by the stove, A-Ling, who has never spoken a word, asks him a question. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 3.

4.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 4 | CC
4.description: One line from Xu Yan, "People aren't things," brings A-Ling's affection back from -5 to -2. Next day, soap takes lard, wood ash and a big pot, and the house has one bowl of rice left. Tang Xiaotang flings open a chest of gold with a bang to pay his debt, but he shuts the lid. Xiaohe gathers ash, Erniu hauls the pot, Qin Shuang drags home a wild boar, and the first batch of soap starts to boil. At midnight, someone is standing by the pot, holding up a bucket of water. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 4.

5.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 5 | CC
5.description: At midnight Lai San, a servant of the Qian household, pours water into Xu Yan's soap pot, until a dagger whistles through the air and pins him to a pillar. Xu Yan doesn't beat him; he makes him stir the pot all night. At dawn the molds come off, and the first batch of snow-white soap lathers up. Mid-count, the System panel suddenly turns red: Married 0/3, 12 double-hours left. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 5.

1-5.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 1–5 | Dub + CC
1-5.description:
Episodes 1–5 of "Farm, Marry, Conquer" back to back, with English dub and subtitles.

Ep. 1: An officer kicks in the door with three wives, and an ag-school grad wakes up a broke scholar in debt
Ep. 2: Three wives from the magistrate, none willing, and the creditor wants a bride for the debt
Ep. 3: Pawn a bride for the debt? The broke scholar rewrites the bond: no people, the money in three days
Ep. 4: A bride opens a chest of gold to pay his debt; he shuts it: "That's your way out"
Ep. 5: Someone ruins the pot at midnight, and the ice-cold bride pins him to a pillar with one dagger
